data.name: Wieslaw
data.gender_notes: Wieslaw is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Wieslaw is a Slavic name composed of 'Wie' (God) and 'Slaw' (glory, fame, or protection). The name may be derived from the Old Polish word 'wies', meaning 'knowledge' or 'God's protection'. Another theory suggests it comes from 'wieslawic', meaning 'God's law'. The name Wieslaw carries the meaning “God's protection, God's law” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wieslaw usually hope their child will grow to embody god's protection, god's law and live with faith, good character and purpose.
